packs.topic: Range of a projectile on level ground
packs.task: Launch a point mass from level ground at speed speed_m_s and angle angle_deg above horizontal under constant downward acceleration gravity_m_s2. Ignore air resistance. Find the horizontal distance in metres to its first return to ground after launch.
picture_checklist: Level ground with launch and landing at the same height
Launch velocity and its angle marked relative to horizontal
Trajectory and horizontal range from launch to landing

packs.topic: Equivalent resistance of a series-parallel circuit
packs.task: An ideal two-terminal network has one resistor of resistance series_ohm in series with two resistors of resistances branch_a_ohm and branch_b_ohm in parallel. Find the equivalent DC resistance in ohms seen at the two outer terminals. Treat connecting wires as ideal.
picture_checklist: Two resistors connected between the same pair of nodes
The third resistor in series with the entire parallel pair

packs.topic: Image distance of a converging thin lens
packs.task: An upright object is object_distance_cm to the left of a converging thin lens in air with focal length focal_length_cm. Use the paraxial thin-lens model. Find the positive distance in centimetres from the lens to the real image on its right.
picture_checklist: Upright object on the incoming side and inverted real image on the outgoing side
At least two principal rays agreeing at the image

packs.topic: Charging time of an RC circuit
packs.task: At time zero, a constant ideal DC source is connected through a resistor resistance_ohm to an initially uncharged capacitor capacitance_f in a series circuit. Find the time in seconds until the capacitor voltage first reaches voltage_fraction of its final voltage.
picture_checklist: Source, resistor, and capacitor in a single series circuit
Charging begins at switch closure or a clearly shown voltage step
The measured capacitor voltage or its target fraction is marked

packs.task: An ideal simple pendulum of length length_m swings in a vertical plane under gravity_m_s2. The point mass is released from rest at amplitude_deg measured from the downward vertical. Find its first full period in seconds using the exact gravitational torque.
picture_checklist: Fixed suspension point and a bob at fixed distance from it
Release angle measured from the downward vertical
Swing arc and both turning points
